values.note: Forest Service: 'maximum trailer length of 25 feet' ('The max length for RVs/trailers is 25 feet'). Two vehicles or one RV per site; up to 8 people.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/michigan-creek-campground ('It has 12 campsites with a maximum trailer length of 25 feet'; 'Parking for two vehicles or one RV is allowed at each site. values.note: No trash service: pack it in, pack it out. Services may be reduced early and late in the season.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/michigan-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site'; 'There is no trash or water service at this campground') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165450 ('This is a "Pack It In - Pack It Out" Facility'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Forest Service: 'open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent'. Dates are recreation.gov's 2026 first-come fee season (2027: May 14 - Oct 10).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/michigan-creek-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165450/rates (First-come Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-11; 2027-05-14 to 2027-10-10), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Strictly first-come; a site must be occupied the same night. Pay at the self-service fee tube (cash, check, money order) or with recreation.gov Scan & Pay.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/michigan-creek-campground ('This campground is strictly first come, first served'; 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay'; 'A self-service fee tube is available for on-site payment. values.note: $22 a site including two vehicles or one RV; $11 a night for a third vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/michigan-creek-campground ('$22 fee per site for overnight camping. values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/michigan-creek-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-28

note: South Park RD, Pike NF: about 4 miles NW of Jefferson off CR 35 and CR 54, at 10,100 ft; campground roads unpaved. Bears are common and a bear closure order applies: keep attractants in hard-sided vehicles or bear boxes. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov Scan & Pay listing: confirmed 12 FCFS sites, max trailer/RV 25 ft (agency), vault toilets, no water/trash, $22; added season 05-15 to 10-11 (FS 'mid-May to mid-October' + rec.gov dates), 14-night limit, fee detail, Senior/Access discount. Note trimmed of field facts.
